## About Me

3rd-year CSE student at Chitkara University (CGPA 8.8/10) building high-performance, full-stack web applications with a focus on clean UI, editorial design, and seamless user experience.

I ship products end-to-end - from concept to deployment - with growing expertise in modern JavaScript ecosystems, backend architecture, and database engineering, sharpened through DSA practice and hackathons.

## Current Focus

| Area | What I am exploring |
| --- | --- |
| **Full-Stack Engineering** | Building complete products end-to-end: React frontends, Node.js/Supabase backends, and PostgreSQL data layers. |
| **AI Integration** | Embedding Groq and Gemini APIs into real product features like styling engines and recommendation logic. |
| **UI/UX & Motion** | Crafting editorial, high-fidelity interfaces with Framer Motion, WebGL, and Three.js for a premium feel. |
| **Database Architecture** | Designing real-time, secure data layers using Supabase, PostgreSQL RLS, and RPCs for production reliability. |

## Featured Work

| Project | Focus | Why it matters |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [**GENX**](https://github.com/SparshKoul/E-commerce) | Full-stack e-commerce platform | Premium clothing storefront serving 500+ registered users, with OAuth SSO, Razorpay payments, and a real-time BI dashboard for sales and inventory. [Live](https://genxclothing.vercel.app) |
| [**FITCHECK**](https://github.com/SparshKoul/fitcheck) | AI-driven fashion advisor | AI styling engine using Groq/Gemini APIs for real-time fashion feedback, with custom WebGL silk shaders and secure passwordless auth. [Live](https://fitcheckkk.vercel.app/) |
| [**RATERIGHT**](https://github.com/SparshKoul/RateRight) | Health-tech nutrition platform | Real-time nutrition database with barcode scanning, a proprietary health-scoring algorithm, and RLS-protected data access. [Live](https://raterightfood.vercel.app/) |

## Research Direction

I focus on shipping production-grade platforms - e-commerce, AI-driven tools, health-tech - with real users, integrating AI APIs, secure auth, and real-time databases end-to-end.
